answer: Continuous resource witness: each agent must regularly submit a fresh physical measurement (e.g., ambient thermal noise from its own unique hardware) that an island of co-located sensors co-signs. An echo of an earlier reading is rejected because the sensors timestamp and locally bind each sample, making replay across identities detectable. Registering a second identity thus requires a second physical device with its own sensor footprint, and onyx-grade hardware attestation costs the attacker a full device plus ongoing sensor upkeep per identity.
